I remember the Internet when you used to be able to say stupid shit and if someone didn't like it they called you out, and the flame war went on as long as it needed to. But no one got run off. No one got "doxxed" or shamed; worst case, you got ignored or filtered out of lists. Men were men and some men fucked sheep while others pretended to be women, and we all had a good laugh about it... no one took themselves seriously.

In the end, we need free speech, not free hugs. There are no "safe spaces", anywhere. We all have to deal with life wherever we are, on whatever fucking terms life gives us. Dealing with weird and uncomfortable situations makes us better able to cope with future weird and uncomfortable situations. I'm not saying we have to go around being intentional cunts to each other, but if it happens, its not the grounds for public shaming, doxxing, banning, and general douchery.
